name: Holytsynske-Hlibivka (Golitsyn-Glebovka) Gas Pipeline, including the first Ochertay-Glebovka string

values.OtherEnglishNames: Golitsyn-Glebovka Gas Pipeline; Ochertay-Glebovka Gas Pipeline (first string)

monitor_reason: length: no source states the length of the first Ochertay-Glebovka string or the offshore Holytsynske-to-shore line; only GulfPub traces (107.8 km, 115.9 km), which are lead-only. Values here are provisional and unreferenced.
researcher_notes: No existing GGIT row (checked the full snapshot for Glebovka, Hlibivka, Holytsynske, Ochertay, Chornomornaftogaz, Crimea names). A 2014 neftegaz.ru report says a parallel Ocheretay-Glebovka line of 42.5 km was planned with pipes ordered, so a first line exists, but its length and diameter are not given. The Russian federal planning scheme, order 816-r annex 4 item 292, lists only the second string (43.65 km, 700 mm) and says it carries gas to the Glebovka storage; that is the separate candidate ochertay-glebovka-2. Searches in Russian and Ukrainian found no sourced length for the first string or the offshore line. The Holytsynske field is on the Black Sea shelf, so the offshore part may be a field or interfield line outside transmission scope. Sources checked: the 2014 neftegaz.ru report and the 816-r annex. Do not stage until a length of 25 km or more is sourced. Territory: Crimea is Ukraine under the naming conventions; the Russian-installed operator would be noted as builder only.
